desc:
Live ANY life from birth to death in this BitLife style experience!

Age up year by year and make choices that actually change your story: family, money, fame, crime, or chaos.

⭐ FEATURES:
Manage Health, Happiness, Smarts, and Looks
Choose your path: school, jobs, relationships, crime, military, and more
Get married, have kids, and leave a legacy
Build friendships, rivals, and family bonds
Buy houses, cars, and other assets
Random events, rare story moments, and unexpected twists
Become the PRESIDENT?!
Play it safe and get rich, or go all-in on risk. No two lives play the same.

 DEVELOPMENT STATUS
RoLife is nearing the end of beta and is actively expanding.
Small bugs may still appear, but fixes are pushed fast.

Other BitLife style games can be fun but feel shallow. Many have been out 1+ year, RoLife is about ~8 months old. Give us time big updates are coming, and we’re here to dominate this genre!

All events in this game are fictional and created purely for fun and entertainment
